title: Meet the Finta Chrome Extension: Aurora, Your AI Copilot for Deal Flow and Relationships
summary: Discover how the new Finta Chrome Extension empowers founders and operators to analyze, save, and act on opportunities instantly with Aurora, your AI copilot.
body_markdown:
## **Introduction: Say Hello to a Smarter Workflow**


Let’s be real: working deals, building relationships, and juggling tools can feel like you’re spinning plates. Whether you’re a founder scouting investors, an operator managing partnerships, or part of a deal-driven sales team mapping your next big move, context is everything.


That’s where the new[Finta Chrome Extension](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/finta/jobflgfkfngkppaphjhljgocldjodngd) comes in.


The new Finta Chrome Extension brings[Aurora, your AI copilot](https://finta.ai/product/aurora) for deals and relationship-driven work, directly into your browser. So you can move faster and stay in flow on any page you visit. With the[Finta Chrome Extension](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/finta/jobflgfkfngkppaphjhljgocldjodngd) , Aurora travels with you across the web to help you research, analyze, and act in real time, without context switching or manual busywork.


You shouldn't have to stop what you're doing to make your CRM useful or actionable. Instead, Finta brings powerful intelligence and real-time support into your browser, keeping you in flow while you chase the next opportunity.


**What You Can Do with Finta’s Chrome Extension**


Let’s break down what makes this extension a must-have for anyone managing high-stakes relationships and deal flows.


### **🧠 Analyze Any Web Page with Aurora**


Gone are the days of copying bios into Google or toggling tabs to figure out who’s who.
Instantly understand people, companies, and opportunities on the page you’re viewing. No copy-pasting, no tool hopping.


Aurora instantly analyzes the information on any page you’re viewing, whether it be LinkedIn, Crunchbase, or even someone’s personal site.


### **⚡ Save Contacts to your CRM on One Click**


Capture people and companies from LinkedIn and across the web and add them directly to your Finta CRM.


Forget the spreadsheet, skip the double-entry, and let Aurora handle the heavy lifting.


### **🔗 Navigate LinkedIn with Context**


Identify mutual connections and map the strongest introduction pathways to prospects already in your network.


You’re not just browsing profiles anymore; you’re mapping your network. Aurora shows you mutual connections and the best intro paths, making cold outreach a thing of the past. Want to know who in your circle can make that warm intro? It’s right there.


### **🤝 Power Warm Introductions**


See how you’re connected and let Aurora help you plan the best next step for thoughtful, high-signal outreach. Think of this as your real-time relationship strategist.


Based on your existing network and CRM, Aurora suggests the best way to reach out.


### **🚀 Keep Deals Moving while you Browse**


Research, relationship-building, and CRM updates happen naturally in the flow of your work.


No context switching. No busywork. Just actionable insights, right when and where you need them.
